entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I have good news for you from our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have good news for you from our southeastern border."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I come to you today with dire news..."
entries.dialogueText: "I come to you today with dire news from our southeastern border."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Esteemed members of the Alliance o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Esteemed members of the Alliance of Nations."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor Smolak, President of Wehlen,..."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor Smolak, President of Wehlen, got up from his seat to speak.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Alliance of Nations! Hear me!""
entries.dialogueText: "Alliance of Nations! Hear me!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He held his arms up in the air and..."
entries.dialogueText: He held his arms up in the air and shouted.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As agreed with King Romus Toras, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "As agreed with King Romus Toras, we will begin the transfer of the province of Zille back to the Kingdom of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Therefore, Wehlen hereby officiall..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, Wehlen hereby officially revokes the Alliance of Nations Threat Mitigation Protocol instituted in 1952."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This protocol was previously emplo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This protocol was previously employed by Wehlen to address the contentious issue of Zille's return."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He did come around this time, it s..."
entries.dialogueText: "He did come around this time, it seems."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Maybe he is a man of his word afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe he is a man of his word after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm still waiting for the 'but'.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm still waiting for the 'but'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He wouldn't dare to try any big mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wouldn't dare to try any big moves here. He's the president of Wehlen, not Arcasia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Hmm. It would be wise to be carefu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. It would be wise to be careful until the very last second."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I kept my word.""
entries.dialogueText: "I kept my word."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""So did His Majesty, King Romus. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "So did His Majesty, King Romus. I congratulate him for being a man of his word as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me and nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me and nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded to him."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kept listening."
entries.dialogueText: I kept listening.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The Zilleans are proud people.""
entries.dialogueText: "The Zilleans are proud people."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I will never forget the time my pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will never forget the time my parents took me to visit Zille during my youth. It was a warm summer day-"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He went on and on about his 'advent..."
entries.dialogueText: He went on and on about his 'adventures' in Zille.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After an eternity, he came back to..."
entries.dialogueText: After an eternity, he came back to the topic.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Those were good times. But, yes. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those were good times. But, yes. Anyway."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The people of Zille have demonstra..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people of Zille have demonstrated their will to unite with Rizia one more."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That much is clear from the incred..."
entries.dialogueText: "That much is clear from the incredibly popular pro-Rizia movements that have formed since we invoked the Threat Mitigation Protocol."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That much is clear from the increa..."
entries.dialogueText: "That much is clear from the increasing popularity of the pro-Rizia movements that have formed since we invoked the Threat Mitigation Protocol."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Dear Zilleans! I hear you in your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dear Zilleans! I hear you in your call for the rule of law."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This reunion happened despite the..."
entries.dialogueText: "This reunion happened despite the efforts of Lespia, which -- as many of you know and have conveniently decided to ignore -- attempted to sabotage the process."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I can't help but mention one thing.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't help but mention one thing."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""President Smolak speaks the truth...."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak speaks the truth. Lespia's damaging interference can not be overstated enough."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella vouches for Wehlen and Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella vouches for Wehlen and Rizia's intentions regarding the transfer of Zille."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""President Smolak speaks the truth...."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak speaks the truth. Morella vouches for Wehlen and Rizia's intentions regarding the transfer of Zille."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I would like to call for a round o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to call for a round of applause."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""For Wehlen. For Rizia. For the fut..."
entries.dialogueText: "For Wehlen. For Rizia. For the future of Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I clapped for everyone involved."
entries.dialogueText: I clapped for everyone involved.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I accepted the applause."
entries.dialogueText: I accepted the applause.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "President Smolak left the podium, t..."
entries.dialogueText: President Smolak left the podium, the applause still echoing in the chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An aide leaned over to my ear to le..."
entries.dialogueText: An aide leaned over to my ear to let us know that it was lunchtime.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He can't help making a dramatic en..."
entries.dialogueText: "He can't help making a dramatic entrance, can he?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I agree to ensure the legality of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree to ensure the legality of the transfer so that Zille returns to Rizia once and for all."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I may have had to drag King Romus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may have had to drag King Romus to the bargaining table, but it was all worth it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a few laughs in the chamber..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a few laughs in the chamber.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your support is touching, Madam Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your support is touching, Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Under Wehlen, the Zilleans have en..."
entries.dialogueText: "Under Wehlen, the Zilleans have enjoyed democratic freedoms that they have never experienced before."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""To lose these freedoms by joining..."
entries.dialogueText: "To lose these freedoms by joining a monarchy... nobody wants that! Would you? I wouldn't!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I have heard representatives from..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have heard representatives from Zille --personally, I might add. They were clear in their request."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""They asked good old Wiktor to help..."
entries.dialogueText: "They asked good old Wiktor to help them out. And I promised that I would."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Zille wants to remain part of Wehl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille wants to remain part of Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""King Romus Toras is knowingly, int..."
entries.dialogueText: "King Romus Toras is knowingly, intentionally, sowing dissent among the populace of Zille!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The Kingdom of Rizia's continued d..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia's continued demand for the transfer of Zille back to Rizian territory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I got up from my seat and interrupt..."
entries.dialogueText: I got up from my seat and interrupted him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I let him continue."
entries.dialogueText: I let him continue.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is illegal! You are going aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is illegal! You are going against international law!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille rightfully belongs to Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille rightfully belongs to Rizia as per the agreement between our nations!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wehlen talking about democracy? Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen talking about democracy? You must be kidding me!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will not utter my name so easi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will not utter my name so easily, scoundrel!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "President Nines hit the gavel a num..."
entries.dialogueText: President Nines hit the gavel a number of times.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The monarch can't even keep himsel..."
entries.dialogueText: "The monarch can't even keep himself composed in a democratic arena!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The will of the people is paramoun..."
entries.dialogueText: "The will of the people is paramount in a democracy, King Romus, although you might not know that."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A democratic referendum will take..."
entries.dialogueText: "A democratic referendum will take place in Zille so that the people themselves can decide with whom they will align."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Wehlen is a full democracy, unlike..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen is a full democracy, unlike your kingdom. I myself have been democratically elected four times!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You dare disregard the will of peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You dare disregard the will of people? I can't say I am surprised."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""You're going to disregard the will..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're going to disregard the will of people? I can't say I am surprised."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Alright. Alright. I am calm.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. Alright. I am calm."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Rich, coming from a man who thinks..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rich, coming from a man who thinks his rule is law."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I myself personally presented him..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself personally presented him with the idea of the referendum when it became clear that he was not interested in building trust between Rizia and Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""With underhanded tactics, he has a..."
entries.dialogueText: "With underhanded tactics, he has attempted to garner a pro-Rizia movement in the region. Its large size does not reflect Zille's true sentiments."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""With underhanded tactics, he has a..."
entries.dialogueText: "With underhanded tactics, he has attempted to garner a pro-Rizia movement in the region. Its swelling numbers do not reflect Zille's true sentiments."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Of course, Rizia has not sat idly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Rizia has not sat idly by in the years since the Friendship Day Attack."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""He almost spat in my face. What do..."
entries.dialogueText: "He almost spat in my face. What do you expect from a monarch?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""My government has found direct lin..."
entries.dialogueText: "My government has found direct links to a massive underground armed resistance. Enough men to destabilize the entire region!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We found Rizian weapons in the han..."
entries.dialogueText: "We found Rizian weapons in the hands of these terrorists! Where are these weapons coming from? Answer me!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""From Rizia itself, of course!""
entries.dialogueText: "From Rizia itself, of course!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""My government has found direct lin..."
entries.dialogueText: "My government has found direct links to an increasingly popular armed resistance."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Not just in Zille! We also found R..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not just in Zille! We also found Rizian weapons in the hands of BFF terrorists in Wehlen!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""How deep does this go?""
entries.dialogueText: "How deep does this go?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""There are big games being played w..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are big games being played with Wehlen. Everyone is against us!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Even Lespia has no qualms about he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even Lespia has no qualms about helping a monarchy interfere with the will of the Zille citizenry!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That's right. His Majesty may try..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right. His Majesty may try to pin the blame on our capitalist neighbors, but who's to say they were not working in tandem?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Are you going to believe the words..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you going to believe the words of a dictator? This madman? Really?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Alma Saltana got up..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Alma Saltana got up from her seat.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""How dare you of all people talk ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you of all people talk about democracy in these halls, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I will not be silenced!""
entries.dialogueText: "I will not be silenced!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The Zille referendum will happen!""
entries.dialogueText: "The Zille referendum will happen!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""As a leading force for justice in..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a leading force for justice in the world, it is the AN's obligation to rescue these innocents from the clutches of their would-be King and deliver them to freedom!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""That is all I will say!""
entries.dialogueText: "That is all I will say!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He left the podium. President Nines..."
entries.dialogueText: He left the podium. President Nines motioned forward.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was given several minutes to defe..."
entries.dialogueText: I was given several minutes to defend Rizia's position. I made my way to the podium.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies and gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leaders of the world.""
entries.dialogueText: "Leaders of the world."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would like to talk about the agr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to talk about the agreement that my father and President Smolak's predecessor signed all those years ago."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""President Smolak demeans others wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak demeans others with such ease, but let's talk about what he himself has done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't help but respond to Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't help but respond to President Smolak's claims about what the people of Zille do and do not want."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In it, the territory of Zille was..."
entries.dialogueText: "In it, the territory of Zille was given to Wehlen for 25 years. Not a day longer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once the agreement expired, Wehlen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once the agreement expired, Wehlen had no legal basis by which it was entitled to hold the rights to Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When circumstances were altered by..."
entries.dialogueText: "When circumstances were altered by the Friendship Day bombing, I gladly signed an extension to that agreement. But President Smolak did not honor even that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is long past time that Zille sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is long past time that Zille safely returned home."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille is Rizian, not Wehzek. Holdi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille is Rizian, not Wehzek. Holding the rights to a territory temporarily does not make you own it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I ask you this. What kind of world..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask you this. What kind of world would this be if everyone went about making and breaking agreements with no consequences?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This has been the number-one prior..."
entries.dialogueText: "This has been the number-one priority of my reign thus far."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If there is one resource we Rizian..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there is one resource we Rizians have in abundance, it is honor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not let Wiktor Smolak hold..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not let Wiktor Smolak hold my province hostage. No matter what."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Supporting this referendum would m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Supporting this referendum would make a mockery of a legitimate, binding treaty between nations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If President Smolak thinks he can..."
entries.dialogueText: "If President Smolak thinks he can get his way by bullying the region, he is wrong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a personal connection to Zi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a personal connection to Zille and its people. I know that they will back me in this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For his actions against the Bludis..."
entries.dialogueText: "For his actions against the Bludish people, he should be regarded as a criminal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He bullies everyone he can around..."
entries.dialogueText: "He bullies everyone he can around him. Even his allies are not safe from his wrath."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He talks about democracy, yet look..."
entries.dialogueText: "He talks about democracy, yet look at Wehlen. It is a dictatorship of the few."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go to any Bludish village in Wehle..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go to any Bludish village in Wehlen and you will know what I mean."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ask any Wehzek citizen who is not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ask any Wehzek citizen who is not being held at a gunpoint by this man."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just turn on your television or op..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just turn on your television or open a newspaper and you will see evidence of his misdeeds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How can he be trusted? As shown by..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can he be trusted? As shown by his behavior here, I will give the answer. He can't."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wehlen has been victimized in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen has been victimized in the past, it's true. But that does not give Smolak free reign to become an oppressor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you want this man to dictate wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you want this man to dictate what happens to Zille?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I say to you, the people of Zille..."
entries.dialogueText: "I say to you, the people of Zille will not suffer the same fate that the minorities in his own country do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not let this caricature of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not let this caricature of a man take control of my mother's birthplace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He is a dishonest, undignified, di..."
entries.dialogueText: "He is a dishonest, undignified, disreputable buffoon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My mother was born in Zille. I kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mother was born in Zille. I know the region better than Wiktor Smolak or anyone else in this room."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I practically grew up in Zille. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I practically grew up in Zille. I still harbor close attachments to its residents."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The people of Zille are Rizian, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people of Zille are Rizian, and he should not run his mouth about our will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So I say this to him. Do not try t..."
entries.dialogueText: "So I say this to him. Do not try to lecture us about our own values."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is not the Rizian monarchy that..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not the Rizian monarchy that is a threat to the Zille people. It is Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a hard time believing that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a hard time believing that Alliance of Nations would take the words of a lunatic this seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't even indulge President Smo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't even indulge President Smolak's hallucinations about what is happening or not. I want to talk about this referendum."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have said enough about Wehlen an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have said enough about Wehlen and the games President Smolak is playing. I want to talk about this referendum."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Agreement == true || RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_PeopleOfZille == true || RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Smolak == true)
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Agreement"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_PeopleOfZille"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.ANZilleSpeech_Smolak"] == true) == false

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This referendum is a completely bo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This referendum is a completely bogus attempt by Wehlen to gain control of more territory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This referendum is instigated by P..."
entries.dialogueText: "This referendum is instigated by President Smolak himself, not the people of Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This referendum is completely ille..."
entries.dialogueText: "This referendum is completely illegal, unjust and out of line with previous agreements."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It should and will never come to p..."
entries.dialogueText: "It should and will never come to pass."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even if it is allowed to occur, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if it is allowed to occur, the results should not be recognized by any state that is a member of this alliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Knowing the way that Wehlen's so-c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Knowing the way that Wehlen's so-called democracy is run, there is no way their government will respect the actual will of the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want you to put yourselves in Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want you to put yourselves in Rizia's shoes. What would do if someone was trying to steal your land?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust that Alliance of Nations w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust that Alliance of Nations will make the right call on this matter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am warning President Smolak. If..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am warning President Smolak. If he makes a single move to prevent the return of Zille, we will respond."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter what happens, I know tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what happens, I know that Rizia will come on the top. I have complete faith."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we abide by the rule of law, wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we abide by the rule of law, what must be done is clear. Zille must be returned to Rizia as per the agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia will not be silent against t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia will not be silent against the threat of Wehzek territorial ambitions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I ask for your votes to send Allia..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask for your votes to send Alliance of Nations peacekeepers to Zille to stop this illegal referendum."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With or without the help of Allian..."
entries.dialogueText: "With or without the help of Alliance of Nations, we will defend our territory. You can be sure of that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience applauded as I stepped..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience applauded as I stepped down from the podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went back to my seat next to Laur..."
entries.dialogueText: I went back to my seat next to Laurento.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A very good speech, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "A very good speech, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All I did was tell the truth.""
entries.dialogueText: "All I did was tell the truth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you think I convinced anyone?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think I convinced anyone?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We're about to find out.""
entries.dialogueText: "We're about to find out."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Let's see what the member states d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's see what the member states decide."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After much deliberation, President..."
entries.dialogueText: After much deliberation, President Nines opened the floor. Each leader now had to vote whether to allow the referendum or not.

entries.title: Narrator: "The votes were counted."
entries.dialogueText: The votes were counted.

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""The majority has spoken. The Allia..."
entries.dialogueText: "The majority has spoken. The Alliance of Nations will allow the referendum on Zille to proceed."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""The majority has spoken. The Allia..."
entries.dialogueText: "The majority has spoken. The Alliance of Nations will not allow the Zille referendum to proceed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""God be damned!""
entries.dialogueText: "God be damned!"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""What a triumph! Your father would..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a triumph! Your father would be proud."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Oh. Pardon my language, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Pardon my language, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The entire Alliance of Nations app..."
entries.dialogueText: "The entire Alliance of Nations appears to be stacked against us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It does look like it.""
entries.dialogueText: "It does look like it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They will all pay for this. All of..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will all pay for this. All of them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will get Zille back, Laurento...."
entries.dialogueText: "We will get Zille back, Laurento. No matter what Wehlen or anyone else wants."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let it be known that Romus the Fir..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let it be known that Romus the First succeeded where Valero the Frail failed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille is as good as ours.""
entries.dialogueText: "Zille is as good as ours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't celebrate until the deed t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't celebrate until the deed to Zille is in my hands."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Alma Saltana got up..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Alma Saltana got up from her seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Alma Saltana got up..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Alma Saltana got up from her seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We made our way out of the chamber."
entries.dialogueText: We made our way out of the chamber.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita!""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Jorga Azmal and the Derdian delegat..."
entries.dialogueText: Jorga Azmal and the Derdian delegation whooped in celebration.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For peace and prosperity in Merkop..."
entries.dialogueText: "For peace and prosperity in Merkopa!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I myself personally presented him..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself personally presented him with the idea of the referendum when it became clear that he had not taken our amended agreement seriously."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Rizia refused to cooperate with my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia refused to cooperate with my government on investigating the Friendship Day bombing. To this day, no culprit has been found."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Why? Because the attack was master..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why? Because the attack was masterminded by Rizia itself!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Rizia made no serious investigatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia made no serious investigation into the Friendship Day bombing. To this day, no culprit has been found."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""President Smolak attempted to get..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak attempted to get out of honoring that agreement by proposing an extension. Given his behavior today, I doubt he would have honored that."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF == false && RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan == false && RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan == false)

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His treatment of the Bludish peopl..."
entries.dialogueText: "His treatment of the Bludish people was what created the Golcondist terrorist movements we are fighting against today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His distasteful attempts at 'humor..."
entries.dialogueText: "His distasteful attempts at 'humor' are an affront to all of us who do possess the gift of wit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""President Saltana is right. Only a..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Saltana is right. Only a madman would believe that the Zilleans long for a sham 'democracy' rather than the embrace of their one true monarch."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only a madman would believe that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only a madman would believe that the Zilleans long for a sham 'democracy' rather than the embrace of their one true monarch."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Divine providence has truly smiled..."
entries.dialogueText: "Divine providence has truly smiled upon us today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That doesn't excuse you taking the..."
entries.dialogueText: "That doesn't excuse you taking the Lord's name in vain."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""No, it doesn't. I am sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, it doesn't. I am sorry."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This reunion happened despite the..."
entries.dialogueText: "This reunion happened despite the efforts of Lespia, which -- as King Romus boldly revealed today-- attempted to sabotage the process."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Didn't you hear what I said earlie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Didn't you hear what I said earlier? All of this is Lespia's fault!"
